description: Return one row per delivery of an event to a network connection, newest first: its state (held, queued, sending, retrying, sent, suppressed or failed), the reason with a one-line explanation (for example consent_suppressed, attributed_only_suppressed or destination_event_too_old), attempts, the last HTTP status, and for a held row when it is expected to be released. Use it to answer why an event did not reach Meta, TikTok or Google. Read scope is enough.

connection_id.description: Only this network connection, as returned by list_integrations.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to fetch the following page. Omit for the first page.

event_id.description: Only this event's deliveries, one per connection that receives it.

from.description: First UTC day the event was received, YYYY-MM-DD. May be sent without to.

install_id.description: Only this install: the install epoch id the events feed and the export call the install id.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-200. The API defaults to 50, so a workspace with more than that needs paging.

network.description: Only connections to this network, for example meta.

to.description: Last UTC day the event was received, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. May be sent without from.

name: list_event_deliveries
title: List what happened to each event sent to ad networks
